name: Nextiva
description: Nextiva is a cloud business phone system and VoIP communications platform combining voice calling, video conferencing, team chat, SMS, and customer relationship management.
best_for: Growing small-to-midsize businesses seeking reliable VoIP phone service with 24/7 live telephone support.
features: Unlimited domestic business calling and SMS throughout the US and Canada
Multi-level auto attendants, call routing schedules, and virtual receptionist
HD video conferencing and screen sharing with up to 250 participants
Integrated team chat, file sharing, and project task management
Voicemail-to-email and voicemail-to-SMS digital audio transcription
Direct integrations with Microsoft Teams, Salesforce, HubSpot, and Outlook

tiers.name: Core
tiers.notes: The annual view shows $15 per user per month (new small business customers on a paid term of 12 months or longer); the monthly view shows $23. Voice calling, business texting, video meetings, call routing, team chat and a mobile app.

tiers.name: Engage
tiers.notes: The annual view shows $25 per user per month on a term of 12 months or longer; the monthly view shows $50.

tiers.name: Scale
tiers.notes: Shown as $75 per user per month in both the monthly and annual views.

tiers.name: Contact center Essential
tiers.notes: Shown as From $75 per agent per month. Professional and Premium contact center plans are priced through sales.

pros: 24/7 live telephone customer support and onboarding assistance
Published 99.999% network uptime SLA on enterprise infrastructure
Unified interface integrating phone, video, chat, and CRM contact details
cons: The pricing page shows two figures for each small business plan and does not say which is annual and which is monthly
Contact center plans are priced per agent, and the Professional and Premium tiers require contacting sales
Real-time AI voice transcription and conversation intelligence are less mature than Dialpad

alternatives.name: RingCentral
alternatives.description: Enterprise unified business communications and PBX telephony leader.
alternatives.best_for: Enterprises needing extensive PBX administration and large international scale

alternatives.name: Dialpad
alternatives.description: AI-powered cloud VoIP platform with live speech transcription and coaching.
alternatives.best_for: Sales and support teams prioritizing live AI call summaries and analytics

alternatives.name: KrispCall
alternatives.description: Modern virtual business phone system for distributed and remote teams.
alternatives.best_for: Remote teams needing international virtual numbers at low cost
